title: How to follow up with your Free IGNYT Sample leads
titleHtml: How to follow up with your Free IGNYT Sample leads
sub: Use these scripts the same day a sample request comes in.

video.title: Funnel scripts training video
video.caption: Watch this before you start calling.

steps.title: Call them
steps.lead: They probably won't pick up, so leave this voicemail:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]!
I saw you just requested a free 3 day sample of IGNYT, and I'm the one getting it in the mail to you.
I only need one thing before it goes out, and that's to make sure I have the right address. I'm going to text you now, so just reply to that and I'll get it sent.

If you don't see my text, check your Unknown Senders or Spam folder. On an iPhone, look for the filter or menu icon in the top right corner of your Messages app, its usually three little lines. On an Android, look for the three-dot menu. You should be able to find any filtered messages there which is where my text to you might be.
Okay, that's all for now! Talk soon.

steps.title: Text them
steps.lead: As soon as you hang up, send this:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! 👋 Just left you a quick voicemail. You requested a free 3 day sample of IGNYT and I want to get it in the mail to you today.
Can you confirm this is where I'm sending it? [Address]
Reply YES and it goes out. It's 3 single serve sticks, one a day in 8oz of water, and it comes out cran-apple.

steps.title: Email them too
steps.lead: Send this the same day. Plenty of people read email before they answer an unknown number:
script: Subject: Confirming where to send your IGNYT sample
Hi [Name],
You requested a free 3 day sample of IGNYT and I'm getting it packed up for you. Before it goes out, can you confirm this address is right? [Address]
Just reply to this email and I'll drop it in the mail. Samples are limited, so the sooner you confirm the sooner yours ships.
[Your Name]

steps.title: Follow up in 24 hrs
steps.lead: If they don't confirm within 24 hours, text again:
script: [Name]! Just following up on my text above! 👆 I still have your IGNYT sample set aside. Send me a quick yes on the address and I'll get it out to you today.

steps.title: Tell them it shipped
steps.lead: Send this the day it actually goes in the mail. Not before:
script: Hey [Name], it's [Your Name]! Just letting you know your IGNYT sample is in the mail and on its way to you. 📦
Can't wait to hear how you like it. One stick in 8oz of water, once a day, for three days. Use a shaker bottle or a coffee frother, it doesn't mix with a spoon. Better over ice.

steps.title: Email the same notice
steps.lead: Send this alongside the text, so it is in both places when they go looking:
script: Subject: Your IGNYT sample is on its way
Hi [Name],
Your free 3 day IGNYT sample went in the mail today and is on its way to you.

When it lands, tear open one stick into 8oz of water, once a day, for three days. Shake it in a shaker bottle or use a small coffee frother, it will not dissolve with a spoon. Most people take it cold over ice. It comes out cran-apple, not a chalky shake.
I'll check in once you have had a chance to try it. Anything you want to know before then, just reply to this.
[Your Name]

steps.title: Check in a few days later
steps.lead: Give it time to arrive and be tried. Five to seven days after you shipped it:
script: Hey [Name]! Did your IGNYT sample land ok? 👋
What did you think? I want to hear the honest answer, good or bad.

tip: Tip: Personalize [Name] and [Your Name], and paste their real address into [Address] before you send. Some people will have already texted you the word SAMPLE from the confirmation page, so check your messages first. If they have, you only need to confirm the address and ship it. Steps 5 to 7 only happen once the sample is physically in the mail, so send them on your own timing, not the same day the lead comes in.
